text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during training.
As Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's routine was
nearing its end—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeeess! Let's keep this momentum for one more lap!
¡Vamos, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
One more lap?
You've already finished today's training, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No-no! El still has plenty of energy left!
The strong must always give it their all, yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Put that way,
I suppose I can't back down.
Very well. Just one lap, alright?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—I've decided!
I'm going to do extra training!!
choice_data_list: I think you've used up all your energy.
I think you've used up all your strength.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—I've decided!
I'm going to do extra training!!
choice_data_list: I think you've used up all your energy.
I think you've used up all your strength.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll give it everything I've got!!
choice_data_list: Make sure you save enough energy to move.
Make sure you save enough energy to move.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah... O-Of course!
Isn't that just a given~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not gonna run until I collapse, obviously~
Ahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi safely completed
her training. I feel glad I gave her a firm reminder
at the end, just to be sure.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: I put the training menu together with that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for acting like I doubted you!
Tsuyoshi's gonna get plenty of rest!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi understood,
and calmly rested her body.
